channel.title: Honolulu Crash Feed
channel.description: Public traffic crash reports for Honolulu / Oʻahu, aggregated from news and official releases. Times in Hawaii Standard Time (HST).

item.title: Serious hit-and-run on Farrington Highway in Waianae
item.description:
Location: Farrington Highway near Waianae Valley Road, Waianae

Crash time: Sep 4, 2026 · 8:58 PM HST

An unidentified westbound motorist struck a 57-year-old female pedestrian near Waianae Valley Road and fled without stopping. The pedestrian was taken to an area hospital in serious condition. HPD Vehicular Homicide Section is investigating.

Source: Honolulu Police Department

item.title: H-1 eastbound dump truck lodged under Waiawa overpass
item.description:
Location: H-1 Freeway eastbound at Waiawa overpass

Crash time: Sep 4, 2026 · 1:08 PM HST

A dump truck traveling east on the H-1 Freeway struck the Waiawa overpass around 1:08 p.m., lodging its trailer under the bridge. Another vehicle struck debris. No injuries reported. Lanes reopened by about 4:30 p.m.

News: Hawaii News Now · HPD

Instagram: @hawaiinewsnow · @kitv4 · @staradvertiser

Credits: Moesolo Upuese Tagovailoa (HNN); HPD; Hawaii DOT

item.title: Pedestrian seriously injured by motorcycle on University Avenue
item.description:
Location: University Avenue & South King Street, Moiliili

Crash time: Sep 4, 2026 · 12:17 AM HST

A 22-year-old female pedestrian was struck by a motorcycle while crossing at University Avenue and South King Street. Honolulu EMS treated her on scene for serious trauma, including facial injuries.

Source: Hawaii News Now (Honolulu EMS)

item.title: Two seriously injured in Kaneohe Bay Drive rollover
item.description:
Location: 190–298 Kaneohe Bay Drive, Kaneohe

Crash time: Sep 3, 2026 · 10:22 PM HST

A 21-year-old male driver and 21-year-old male passenger sustained serious injuries in a single-vehicle rollover. Honolulu EMS responded with multiple units.

Credits: Ancheta, Dillon | HNN

item.title: Pickup rollover at Kahekili and Likelike highways
item.description:
Location: Kahekili Highway & Likelike Highway, Kaneohe

Crash time: Sep 3, 2026 · 10:15 PM HST

A 23-year-old male pickup truck driver was hospitalized in serious condition after striking a highway median and rolling onto its top. Honolulu EMS treated the driver for multiple injuries around 10:15 p.m.

Source: Hawaii News Now

item.title: Fatal rollover on Bingham Street in McCully
item.description:
Location: 1900 block of Bingham Street, McCully

Crash time: Sep 1, 2026 · 11:50 PM HST

A vehicle carrying four occupants sideswiped a parked car, overturned, and struck a fire hydrant. The 26-year-old driver later died; a 25-year-old passenger was critically injured. HFD extricated two occupants. Oʻahu’s 26th traffic fatality of 2026.

News: HNN · Star-Advertiser · KITV · HFD

Credits: HNN; Star-Advertiser (photo Honolulu EMS); KITV; HFD
